experiment_data.hypothesis: A pilot-proxy regime-aware selector that chooses independent estimation in negative CATE-error correlation regimes and partial-pooling otherwise can improve downstream CATE RMSE win rate over fixed partial-pooling and fixed independent across the e008 DGP grid, while retaining partial-pooling gains in high-severity positive-correlation cells.

spec.command: bash -c "set -euo pipefail; cd /root/ec_hte; mkdir -p docs/results logs; /root/miniconda3/bin/python experiments/e009_regime_aware_estimator_selection.py --n 5000 --reps 100 --budgets 500 2000 --seed 20260531 --out docs/results/e009_regime_aware_estimator_selection.json 2>&1 | tee logs/e009_regime_aware_estimator_selection.log"
spec.data_path: synthetic DGP grid generated by experiments/e009_regime_aware_estimator_selection.py using e008 DGP family and e002 Stage 1 functions
spec.checkpoint_source: e008_stage1_dgp_robustness mixed/condition-specific result and D010 regime-aware selection decision; no model checkpoint used
spec.eval_data: same synthetic DGP grid as e008: subgroup_count=[4,6,8], misclassification_severity=[low,medium,high], cate_error_correlation=[positive,zero,negative], n=5000, reps=100, budgets=[500,2000]

selector_rules.pilot_corr_selector: Estimate independent row-wise error rates from finite expert labels, estimate preliminary subgroup CATE magnitudes from observed noisy labels, compute corr(error_proxy, abs(observed_tau)); choose independent if proxy correlation < -0.10, otherwise partial_pooling.
selector_rules.pilot_corr_severity_selector: Use the same proxy correlation plus max estimated row error severity proxy; choose independent if proxy corr < -0.20, or if proxy corr < -0.10 and max estimated row error < 0.25; otherwise partial_pooling, preserving high-severity nonnegative-correlation partial-pooling behavior.
selector_rules.oracle_regime_selector: Upper bound that chooses the lower realized CATE RMSE between partial_pooling and independent inside each replication; not deployable.

metrics: selector decision accuracy for negative-correlation cells
spec.notes: D010 follow-up. Local dry-run and remote dry-run passed before submission. Formal run uses requested reps=100 on the full e008 27-cell grid.
